name: Republic City High
source:
OMG! It’s your first day at Republic City High School! You just went there for the cute uniform, but you may find the love of your life! Uncle Tenzin wakes you up and you rush to school. A hottie on a moped hits you. Her name is Asami. Choose to be nice or mean….

Tarlock -senpai is your homeroom teacher. Choose who to sit next to, Bolin, Tarlock, or Asami. You have the option of meeting with them after class, or ignoring them all!

First impressions always matter. Who will you sit next to? 

-The sexy waterbender who happens to be your Sensei?

-The hottie earthbender who keeps staring at you?

-The beautiful non-bender who ran you over with her moped?

You choose. Will you get laid or create lifetime friendships?

[From the description of Chapter 1 at [url=http://avatarem.deviantart.com/art/Republic-City-High-Ch-1-The-First-Day-at-School-358724326]DeviantArt[/url]]
translation:
我的天啊！这是你在共和城高中的第一天！你去那里只是为了可爱的制服，但你可能会找到你一生的挚爱！丹增叔叔叫醒你，你就赶去学校。一个骑轻便摩托车的辣妹袭击了你。她的名字叫麻美。选择友善或刻薄……

Tarlock-前辈是你的班主任。选择坐在谁旁边：Bolin、Tarlock或Asami。你可以选择在课后与他们见面，或者忽略他们！

第一印象总是很重要。你会坐在谁旁边？

-那个性感的水师恰好是你的老师？

-那个一直盯着你看的辣妹地球人？

-那个漂亮的不酗酒的人用她的轻便摩托车撞倒了你？

你选择。你会上床还是建立终生的友谊？

[来自第1章的描述[url=http://avatarem.deviantart.com/art/Republic-City-High-Ch-1-The-First-Day-at-School-358724326]异常艺术[/url]]
